title: Decision Reviews and Appeals: Schedule of Request Forms and Filing Periods
content:
## Decision Reviews and Appeals — schedule of request forms and filing periods

Every lane of Decision Reviews and Appeals reviews a decision VA has already issued: a request in any of the six lanes requires a prior decision under review, and it is made on the form that lane uses. The schedule below states, lane by lane, the period for filing after the notice of the decision, the period that applies when another claimant contests the same benefit, the form, the fee, whether the filing deadline can be extended for good cause, and whether an intent to file can protect the date of the request.

| Lane | Request form | Filing period after the notice of the decision (calendar days) | Filing period in a contested claim (calendar days) | Filing fee (USD) | Deadline extendable on a showing of good cause | Intent to file can protect the date of the request |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supplemental Claim | VA Form 20-0995 | 365 | 60 | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Higher-Level Review | VA Form 20-0996 | 365 | 60 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference | VA Form 20-0996 | 365 | 60 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Board Appeal - Direct Review Docket | VA Form 10182 | 365 | 60 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Board Appeal - Evidence Submission Docket | VA Form 10182 | 365 | 60 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Board Appeal - Hearing Docket | VA Form 10182 | 365 | 60 | 0 | Yes | No |

### Notes to the schedule

1. **Filing period.** The number of calendar days after the date of the notice of the decision under review within which the request must be received. The figure is 365 calendar days in every lane.
2. **Contested claim.** Where another claimant contests the same benefit, the request must be filed within 60 calendar days. The figure is the same in every lane.
3. **Forms.** Three forms serve the six lanes: VA Form 20-0995 for a Supplemental Claim; VA Form 20-0996 for both Higher-Level Review lanes, with or without the informal conference; and VA Form 10182 for all three Board dockets.
4. **Fee.** No lane charges a fee to request review; the fee is 0 USD in each.
5. **Good cause.** In every lane the filing deadline may be extended on a showing of good cause, whether that showing is filed before or after the deadline.
6. **Intent to file.** An intent to file can protect the date of a request in the Supplemental Claim lane only. In the two Higher-Level Review lanes and on the three Board dockets it cannot.

### Readings of the schedule

**Does the Board have a longer filing period than the regional office lanes?** No. The filing period is 365 calendar days after the notice of the decision in all six lanes, Board dockets included.

**Is a Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference requested on a different form from a Higher-Level Review?** No. Both are requested on VA Form 20-0996.

**Which lane lets an intent to file protect the date of the request?** The Supplemental Claim lane, and no other.

**What filing period applies when a second claimant contests the same benefit?** 60 calendar days, in whichever lane the request is made.
